source: Bank KRI Library Sample.xlsx (17 sheets), normalised by hand; every row keeps its sheet, row and the three levels as written
boundaries: green_threshold and red_threshold are the two boundaries KriBandRule::bandColumns() takes. The engine edges are frozen (ADR 0026 s6.1): higher-is-worse green is value < green, red is value >= red; lower-is-worse green is value > green, red is value <= red. The sheet speaks in <= and > wording, so each boundary sits one reading step past the sheet number: 1 for a count, 0.01 for anything continuous.

kris.name: Number of dealer limit breaches observed in a month
kris.description: Measures instances where approved dealer trading limits were exceeded. Breaches indicate increased market and operational risk arising from trading outside authorised risk boundaries.

kris.name: Number of deals executed without authorization but ratified later
kris.description: Tracks transactions executed without prior approval but subsequently ratified.Breaches signal weaknesses in governance and approval controls and increase the risk of unauthorised exposure.

kris.name: Number of days NOP was breached
kris.description: Measures the number of days FX exposure exceeded approved or regulatory limits. Breaches indicate heightened sensitivity to adverse exchange-rate movements and increased market risk exposure.

kris.name: Number of days liquidity ratio was breached
kris.description: Tracks the number of days the liquidity ratio fell below approved or regulatory thresholds. Breaches signal funding stress and increased risk to the Bank’s ability to meet short-term obligations.

kris.name: % of budget achievement (Revenue)
kris.description: Measures actual revenue performance against the approved budget. Persistent under-achievement indicates potential weaknesses in business assumptions, execution challenges, or revenue generation risk.

kris.name: % of excess costs over budget
kris.description: Tracks the proportion of actual expenditure exceeding approved budget limits. Elevated levels signal weak cost controls, poor budgeting discipline, or emerging financial strain.

kris.name: Instance of default/late tax payment.
kris.description: Measures occurrences where statutory tax obligations are paid late or defaulted. Such instances expose the Bank to penalties, reputational damage, and regulatory non-compliance.

kris.name: Instances of delay in submission of regulatory reports.
kris.description: Tracks delays in submitting required regulatory returns within stipulated timelines. Repeated delays indicate governance weaknesses and increase regulatory and supervisory risk.

kris.name: Number of penalties paid due to inaccurate returns.
kris.description: Measures penalties incurred as a result of inaccurate or erroneous regulatory submissions. This signals deficiencies in data quality, review controls, and reporting accuracy.

kris.name: Number of restricted GLs opened to direct posting for all without approval
kris.description: Tracks instances where restricted General Ledger accounts are opened for direct posting without appropriate authorization. Such breaches increase the risk of unauthorized or erroneous entries.

kris.name: Number of GL’s opened for direct posting without approval
kris.description: Measures the number of General Ledger accounts enabled for direct posting without formal approval. Indicates control overrides and heightened risk of financial misstatement.

kris.name: Number of new GL’s created without approval
kris.description: Tracks the creation of new General Ledger accounts outside approved governance processes. Such occurrences weaken chart-of-accounts integrity and financial control discipline.

kris.name: Number of GL’s closed without approval
kris.description: Measures unauthorized closure of General Ledger accounts. Indicates control lapses that may obscure audit trails or financial transparency.

kris.name: Number of Income reversal
kris.description: Tracks the frequency of income entries reversed after initial recognition. High occurrences suggest weak revenue recognition controls or data integrity issues.

kris.name: Amount of Income reversal
kris.description: Measures the total value of reversed income. Large or increasing amounts indicate heightened risk of misstated revenues and unreliable financial reporting.

kris.name: Percentage of financial entries executed without prior approval but ratified later.
kris.description: Tracks the proportion of financial entries processed without prior authorization and subsequently ratified. Signals governance weaknesses and elevated risk of unauthorized transactions.

kris.name: Number of times Maintenance/process change on Flexcube without approval
kris.description: Measures instances of unapproved system maintenance or process changes on Flexcube. Such actions expose the Bank to system instability, data integrity risk, and audit concerns.

kris.name: Number of Product designs/adverts/publications not published within TAT.
kris.description: Measures instances where approved product or marketing materials were not released within agreed turnaround times, indicating process inefficiencies and potential delays in business execution or campaigns.

kris.name: No of Product designs/adverts that are unappealing or not in compliance with the Bank’s brand standards.
kris.description: Tracks instances where published materials fail to meet the Bank’s branding or quality standards, signalling weaknesses in review controls and brand governance.

kris.name: Number of negative media reports against the Bank
kris.description: Measures adverse media mentions that may impact the Bank’s reputation, signalling emerging reputational and conduct risks.

kris.name: Number social media post with inaccurate information.
kris.description: Tracks instances of incorrect or misleading information published on official social media channels, indicating gaps in content verification and approval controls.

kris.name: Vendor breach or noncompliance

kris.name: Number of negative publicity (Social Media)

kris.name: Number of Delays in VPN access, server access

kris.name: Percentage of dropped or unanswered customer calls

kris.name: Average Wait Time ( Customer average wait time on queue)
kris.description: Captures the average time customers spend waiting in queue before being attended to, indicating service accessibility and operational efficiency.

kris.name: Customer Satisfaction Rating ( Measures customer satisfaction after interaction)

kris.description: Measures the total number of fresh legal cases filed against the Bank within the reporting period. It indicates the Bank’s exposure to legal disputes and potential operational, contractual, or compliance weaknesses.

kris.name: Number of garnishee/Court orders relayed late by branches in a month

kris.name: Total amount of judgement debt against the Bank for the month
kris.description: Represents the monetary value of court-awarded liabilities against the Bank during the period. It reflects financial exposure arising from concluded legal cases.

kris.name: Number of lawsuits filed by vendors against the bank

kris.name: Number of titles pledged as collateral and not registered in Banks Interest
kris.description: Measures collateral documentation risk, showing how many pledged titles have not been legally perfected in the Bank’s name. This exposes the Bank to credit losses in case of default.

kris.name: Court Injunctions on our Premises
kris.description: Counts the number of legal orders restricting the Bank’s operations (e.g., sealing of premises or restriction of activities). This is a high-impact indicator of legal and reputational risk.

kris.name: Legal suits by retainers (e.g. landlords etc)
kris.description: Tracks cases brought by contracted parties such as landlords or outsourced service providers. It reflects issues in contractual obligations, lease agreements, or service-level compliance.

kris.name: Legal suits by Ex-staff
kris.description: Measures the number of lawsuits filed by former employees, often relating to wrongful termination, benefits, or employment disputes. Indicates HR and labour law risk exposure.

kris.name: Legal suits against executive management
kris.description: Captures cases where senior management (e.g., directors, executives) are personally named in legal actions. This represents heightened governance, reputational, and regulatory risk.

kris.name: No of reports not sent to regulators as at when due
kris.description: Tracks regulatory compliance lapses where required filings are delayed or missed. This is a key indicator of compliance risk and may lead to penalties or supervisory action.

kris.name: Percentage of ongoing perfections
kris.description: Measures the proportion of collateral/security documentation that has been successfully perfected relative to total initiated.Formula: (Number perfected ÷ Total requiring perfection) × 100. Indicates the efficiency of collateral management processes.

kris.name: Number of property acquired without legal search.
kris.description: Captures instances where property acquisitions were completed without conducting due diligence (title search). This exposes the Bank to ownership disputes and fraud risk.

kris.name: Number of property acquired without complete documentation.
kris.description: Measures how many acquired properties lack full legal documentation (e.g., title deeds, approvals). This reflects potential ownership, enforceability, and compliance risks.

kris.name: Number of Medium to Critical software defects identified post-release
kris.description: Measures the number of significant software issues detected after deployment, indicating weaknesses in testing, quality assurance, and release management processes.

kris.name: Total Number of Critical Virtual Machines Backup Failures

kris.name: Total Number of Database Backup Failures (monthly)

kris.name: Number of applications deployed without change management control
kris.description: Captures instances where systems are deployed without following formal change management procedures, indicating governance and control failures.

kris.name: Number of High Risk Changes
kris.description: Measures the volume of system changes classified as high risk, reflecting the level of exposure to potential system instability or disruption.

kris.name: Number of reported cases of laptop theft
kris.description: Tracks incidents of stolen laptops, indicating potential data loss, security breaches, and physical asset control weaknesses.

kris.name: Monthly average time for EOD exercise

kris.name: Time for EOM exercise
